modules.name: minisvc.cli
modules.purpose: Console-script bootstrap: loads environment settings, creates the repository, initializes the SQLite schema, and reports readiness.

modules.name: minisvc.config
modules.purpose: Defines immutable runtime settings and maps MINISVC_DB and MINISVC_READONLY environment variables to Settings.

modules.name: minisvc.models
modules.purpose: Defines the Order domain data object.

modules.name: minisvc.api.routes
modules.purpose: Registers POST and GET order routes on an injected application object.

modules.name: minisvc.api.handlers
modules.purpose: Transforms request data into orders, delegates persistence, and builds create/read response dictionaries.

modules.name: minisvc.audit
modules.purpose: Builds in-memory order event dictionaries for API responses.

modules.name: minisvc.storage.repo
modules.purpose: Persists and retrieves orders in a SQLite database and creates the orders table.

modules.name: minisvc
modules.purpose: Package marker and limited __all__ declaration; not business logic.

modules.name: minisvc.api
modules.purpose: API package marker; no runtime business logic.

modules.name: minisvc.storage
modules.purpose: Storage package marker; no runtime business logic.

key_functions.description: Loads settings, constructs OrderRepository, initializes schema, prints readiness, and returns 0; it does not start an HTTP server.
Returns Settings(database_path, readonly) from environment values, defaulting to orders.sqlite and false.
Binds POST /orders and GET /orders/<order_id> using lambdas that delegate to handlers.
Reads required payload keys, converts total_cents with int(), saves the Order, and returns a created response with an in-memory event.
Looks up an order and returns either missing or ok plus a read event.
Creates the orders table if absent using a short-lived SQLite connection.
Inserts one order with parameterized SQL; duplicate IDs or other SQLite errors propagate.
Queries one order by parameterized order_id and reconstructs Order or returns None.
Formats an order action event as a dictionary; it performs no persistence.

runtime_flows.name: CLI startup
steps: Console script minisvc resolves to minisvc.cli:main.
main calls repo.init_schema(), creating SQLite orders if needed.
main prints the database path and returns 0; no HTTP listener is launched by this function.

runtime_flows.name: HTTP create-order
steps: POST /orders dispatches to create_order(payload, repo) through a registered lambda.
create_order reads order_id, customer, and total_cents and converts total_cents to int.
create_order constructs Order and calls OrderRepository.save, inserting into SQLite orders.
create_order calls order_event(order, 'created') and returns status, order_id, and the event; no audit row is written.
